nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card beside the whole question. Two-point items (“3 mharc + 2 mharc”, or Reading B 2(a)’s bare “5 mharc” with “An chéad rud atá ceart = 3 mharc; an dara rud atá ceart = 2 mharc”) are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers allow 0/5, or 0/3/5 where the scheme prints a 3-mark partial answer (“= 3 mharc”, or A 3(b)’s “… is fiú 3 mharc an freagra.”).
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): (a) Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille, each printing five sub-questions the scheme prices at 5: each text is a 25-mark card (different Atlas headings) and every sub-question is also a practice card. (b) Hurlamaboc is one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3).

Prescribed poetry (3A): each poem is a whole 25-mark card with its printed tariffs ((a) Colscaradh: (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9; (b) An tEarrach Thiar: (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9) and one 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; every printed sub-question is also a practice card. Colscaradh (iii) prints two questions, (a) 2 and (b) 7, and An tEarrach Thiar (i) three, (a) 2, (b) 2 and (c) 2 + 2: each is its own practice card, and (i) keeps 0/2/4/6/8.

Optional prose (2B) and optional poetry (3B) stay whole: the text is open content chosen by the candidate. 2B(a)’s optional film or play is one card with both printed alternatives (one scheme); 3B(b) asks for a modern poem not used in 3B(a).
Choice is not a route: Ceist 2 and Ceist 3 are each A or B; each printed question is one card carrying the printed choice and “Freagair (a) agus (b) anseo.”; no combination cards.
Literature language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 25-mark question, never inside one sub-question.
caveats: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 reading 100 (A Slí an Atlantaigh Fhiáin – Turas a fhanfaidh i do chuimhne 50, B Kíla – Tríocha Bliain ar an mBóthar 50; ten questions at (a) 5 + (b) 5 each), Ceist 2 prose 50 (A Prós Ainmnithe: (a) Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille 25 + (b) Hurlamaboc 25; or B Prós Roghnach: (a) an optional film or play 25 + (b) an optional novel extract 25), Ceist 3 poetry 50 (A Filíocht Ainmnithe: (a) Colscaradh 25 + (b) An tEarrach Thiar 25; or B Filíocht Roghnach: (a) 25 + (b) 25).

The scheme’s text layer stores nine boxed headings with the page body (“CEIST 1 (A + B) - LÉAMHTHUISCINT - 100 marc”, “A – (50 marc)”, “B – (50 marc)”, the CEIST 2/3 and section boxes; the CEIST 2 box sits inside Cáca Milis (iii)’s sample answers on PDF 19); the builder removes those exact strings (count pinned).

Each reading passage prints one note above Ceist 1 (“Nóta: Má tá dhá phointe eolais i gceist, tá 3 mharc ar an gcéad cheann atá ceart agus 2 mharc ar an dara ceann atá ceart.”), carried with every part’s key; the penalty note (“Nóta: Gearrfar pionós i ngeall ar iomarcaíocht. Léireofar an pionós …”) and the mark boxes close each passage, and the last part’s key ends before them.

The 2017 reading key prices points several ways, all lifted as printed: “= rud amháin”, “= fáth amháin”, “= píosa eolais amháin” and “= 2 phíosa eolais = 3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc” (Reading B 2(a), 3(b), 4(a)); one full answer “= 3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc” beside its single points; lists priced “Aon dá cheann … = 3 mharc + 2 mharc” or “2 cheann ón liosta = 3 mharc + 2 mharc” (A 2(a), A 5(b), B 5(b)); and A 3(b)’s bracketed “(Má fhágtar ainmfhocal nó aidiacht amháin ar lár is fiú 3 mharc an freagra.)”.

Each literature answer ends with a “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 …]” note, printed with a closing full stop on the six prose answers (Cáca Milis, An Lasair Choille, Hurlamaboc, the 2B film, the 2B play, 2B(b)) and without one on the four poems; each card carries its own printed form as the deduction criterion. The literature sample note (“… na freagraí thuasluaite …”) is printed below 2A (PDF 23) and below 3A (PDF 27), word for word. The 2017 scheme prints no “Léirigh mionbhriseadh na marcanna” mark-panel line.

2B(a) prices the optional film and the optional play alike: the most-liked character 1, “Na heachtraí is mó a tharlaíonn don duine sin … = 22 marc” with “5 phointe eolais ag teastáil (5 mharc an ceann ar an gcéad dhá phointe eolais + 4 mharc an ceann ar na trí phointe eolais eile.) (23 marc)”, title 1 + writer 1. 2B(b) prices “Príomhthéama an ghiota = 3 mharc” and “4 phointe eolais ag teastáil (5 mharc an ceann) = 20 marc”, title 1 + author 1.

An Lasair Choille (iii): the paper prints “Scríobh síos dhá phíosa eolais faoin saol atá ag Míoda lena hathair, dar léi féin.”; the scheme prints it without “síos”. The card’s question is the paper’s print; the scheme slice is lifted as printed. An Lasair Choille (iii) and (iv) price “2 mharc + 3 mharc” (the reverse of Cáca Milis (i)/(ii)’s “3 mharc + 2 mharc”); both are lifted as printed.

3A(b)(i) An tEarrach Thiar prints three questions, (a) “(2 mharc)”, (b) “(2 mharc)” and (c) “(2 mharc + 2 mharc)”, each with “Freagraí Samplacha:” and the verse lines it draws on (“Véarsa a haon, Línte 3 + 4 = 2 mharc”); Colscaradh (iii) prints (a) “(2 mharc)” and (b) “(7 marc)” (Is/Ní réiteach sásúil é = 1 mharc; Dhá fháth = 3 mharc + 3 mharc), the paper’s (9 marc) covering both.
The paper prints “‐” (U+2010) in “nua‐aimseartha”, “t‐eolas”, “t‐albam”, “t‐atmaisféar” and “diaidh‐thrá”; cards print the ASCII hyphen, as the scheme does.
No 2017 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 60 cards are new.
